scientific_question: Given a directed biological contrast, do unresolved MS/MS entities add reliable retrieval of related or opposite study responses, and does the in-house algorithm add value beyond the same evidence processed by existing methods?
unit: study x contrast with entity-level beta and SE
candidate_policy: Every source-disjoint target contrast remains in the denominator; missing evidence causes abstention, never candidate deletion.

identity.allowed_operation: rank identity candidates, then accumulate beta/SE only for an accepted same-entity hypothesis

relation.meaning: different entities with a calibrated local chemical relationship
relation.candidate_universe: a model-independent relation universe; the current fragment-admitted fixed graph is development reweighting only
relation.allowed_operation: aggregate response-pattern evidence without merging entity effects

primary_factorization.unknown_increment: all minus the draw-wise strongest of known_only, measurement_matched_known and unresolved_shuffled_ms2
primary_factorization.algorithm_increment: method replacement within the identical evidence world, candidate universe and response operator
primary_factorization.joint_increment: difference in differences between Full23 and WSE on identity-track all versus strongest-control worlds

truth_classes.correct_answer: relation fixed before score development and confirmed by independent evidence not used for matching, parameter selection or response construction
truth_classes.supported_hypothesis: consumed or post-hoc relation with orthogonal support but no independent confirmation
truth_classes.abstain: identity, coverage, design comparability or truth is inadequate
truth_classes.not_a_negative: an unregistered pair or a pair lacking evidence

required_chain: algorithm changes a legal entity or relation decision
unresolved information adds beyond matched controls
the change alters a study-level response answer
